title: Matthew Stafford moves into tie for sixth on all-time TDs list as Rams take 14-0 lead

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matthew Stafford moves into tie for sixth on all-time TDs list as Rams take 14-0 lead
sources.description: Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford moved into a tie for sixth on the NFL's all-time passing touchdowns list on Monday night.
